description: A small, exactly hand-computable NWPVerificationMetrics.evaluate_all() case - errors are [0, 0, -1, 1] (bias=0 exactly, mae=0.5 exactly, rmse=sqrt(0.5) exactly) and the threshold=3.0 contingency table is a perfect forecast (hits=2, false_alarms=0, misses=0, correct_negatives=2, so pod=1, far=0, csi=1, ets=1 exactly) - verifiable by hand, not just by rerunning the code that produced it, so this golden dataset also catches a bug shared between the code and a test that only re-derives its own expectation from the same (possibly wrong) formula.
